description: Textbook PayPal credential phish: display-name impersonation, lookalike domain, account threat, urgency, generic salutation, anchor/href mismatch.

email.subject: Your PayPal account has been limited - action required within 24 hours
email.bodyText:
Dear Customer,

We have detected unusual activity on your PayPal account. As a precaution your account access has been limited until you confirm your identity.

What this means: you cannot send or receive money, and any pending transactions are on hold.

To restore full access you must verify your account information immediately. If you do not confirm your details within 24 hours your account will be permanently suspended and any remaining balance will be held for review.

Confirm your account now: https://www.paypal.com/signin

Failure to respond will result in permanent closure. This is your final notice.

Sincerely,
The PayPal Security Team
